idea: Use H17 Chokudai planning after applying the one-refuel role correction
lesson: The role correction is valuable, but H17 planning discards the production ALNS trajectory on this case. Keep production ALNS as H24's plan engine.

idea: Increase boundary continuation width from four to eight without a cheap ranking stage
lesson: The measured run consumed up to about 42.3 seconds per day without beating the narrower pool family. This single run rejects default promotion, not the algorithm universally; try cheaper preview ranking first.

idea: Bounded one/two-car tail Chokudai as an additional route-pool improvement
lesson: The run generated 1288 macro candidates, but the selected 54+34 two-day forecast came from DP/pool, not tail search. No independent gain established; keep the optional operator disabled pending a positive ablation. Forecasts are not final match scores.

case: 16x16/24x24/32x32 supplied cases; first day only; two seeds
idea: Promote the boundary-preview solver as a universal default based on the 25x25 gains
lesson: Four ties and two one-bowl losses; all preview runs retained their ALNS seed. Timing-dependent seed generation differs, so this is not proof the pool harms routes, but the general non-regression/promotion gate is not met. Do not replace legacy defaults.
